note: Pipeline math uses catalog list prices. It is not booked. It is not recognized revenue.

pricing_models.note: A la carte desk attach. Not a fourth SKU.

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1 and stops.
scenarios.name: One controller — L1 only

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1, kit PASS, then attaches P-ADM.
scenarios.name: One controller — L1 then P-ADM

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1, attaches P-ADM, then pays for U-DUAL.
scenarios.name: One controller — all three SKUs

scenarios.if: Three controllers each buy L1 and attach P-ADM. No named buyers exist.
scenarios.name: Three controllers — L1 + P-ADM each

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1 and four billable days on the same plane.
scenarios.name: One L1 plus four FFS days

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1 then attaches industry.cascade for their customers' AI.
scenarios.name: One L1 plus counterparty AI desk

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1, attaches P-ADM, then attaches industry.second_record.
scenarios.name: One controller — L1, P-ADM, second-record keep

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1 then attaches industry.off_switch so humans can freeze writes.
scenarios.name: One L1 plus off-switch desk

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1, attaches P-ADM, then attaches industry.board for owner/board/examiner evidence.
scenarios.name: One controller — L1, P-ADM, board keep

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1, attaches P-ADM, then attaches industry.internal_audit for the seating map.
scenarios.name: One controller — L1, P-ADM, internal-audit keep

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1 then attaches industry.payables and industry.bank.
scenarios.name: One L1 plus payables and bank desks

scenarios.if: One controller buys L1, attaches P-ADM, then attaches industry.oversight.
scenarios.name: One controller — L1, P-ADM, oversight keep

scenarios.if: One controller buys all three SKUs then attaches industry.invoice_desk and industry.credit.
scenarios.name: All three SKUs plus invoice and credit desks
